title: Password spray against 42 user accounts from a single external IP
log_snippet: 4625 logon failures for 42 distinct users in 10 minutes from 203.0.113.66; password spray pattern, 3 attempts per account, no successful logons yet.

title: Successful login from impossible-travel location followed by inbox rule creation
log_snippet: Successful logon from 198.51.100.77 (new country) 38 minutes after a local logon; impossible travel; a forwarding inbox rule to an external example domain was created 4 minutes later.

title: Encoded PowerShell command downloading a payload from an external domain
log_snippet: powershell.exe -enc launched from an email attachment; outbound connection to payload.example.net at 203.0.113.99; unsigned binary written to the user temp folder.

title: Administrator PowerShell activity during scheduled maintenance
log_snippet: Signed PowerShell maintenance script run by a named admin during an approved change window; scheduled maintenance on a managed server, commands match the change ticket, no external connections.

title: Port scan of internal subnets from a single internal host
log_snippet: SYN sweep across 3 internal subnets from 198.51.100.10; source is the authorized vulnerability scanner running its weekly scheduled scan window.

title: New access key created for a service account after an admin policy was attached outside the change window
log_snippet: AttachUserPolicy AdministratorAccess to svc-reports, then CreateAccessKey, at 03:52 local, outside change window, from a previously unseen IP 203.0.113.120.

title: MFA push fatigue: 14 prompts sent, 1 approved by the user
log_snippet: 14 MFA push prompts in 22 minutes for s.novak; user states they did not initiate the logons; the 14th prompt was approved; source IP 203.0.113.66 also seen in password spray activity.

title: Mass file rename with a ransom note on a file server
log_snippet: 1,840 files renamed with a .locked extension in 6 minutes; ransom note README-LOCKED.txt dropped in multiple shares; volume shadow copies deleted.

title: Large DNS TXT queries to a newly registered example domain
log_snippet: 4,200 DNS TXT queries in 1 hour to tunnel.example.net with long encoded subdomains; ~38 MB of query payload from a single workstation, far above baseline.

title: Storage bucket policy changed to public read
log_snippet: Bucket policy changed to public read by a developer account during business hours. Bucket name suggests test data, but the data classification tag is missing, so contents cannot be confirmed from the alert alone.

title: Workstation running a port scan against one internal server
log_snippet: nmap-style port scan from an intern workstation against a single internal server; user is enrolled in a security training lab this week, but the scanned server is not on the lab target list.

title: Dormant service account used for an interactive login
log_snippet: Interactive login for svc-backup after 182 days of dormancy, from its usual office location and device; service accounts should not log in interactively, but no other malicious behaviour is present in the alert.
